items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Bob; the mention comes from the interviewer stating 'Bob's over again' in reference to the interviewee's mother's sister.

ctx.x: Yeah, I'm just like my head. But that's the first thing he said, oh, Bob's over again. That was my mother's sister.
His wife, but he had died of that.
